title: Print summary output after applying feature changes
description: After successfully writing PRD.md and tasks.json, print a formatted summary showing the feature name, number of tasks added, PRD section updated, and a suggestion to run rocket loop.
acceptanceCriteria: Feature name is printed after applying changes
Number of tasks added is shown
PRD section name that was updated is shown
'rocket loop' suggestion is printed in cyan
Summary uses green for success, cyan for suggested command

steps.details: After writeFeatureSpec and mergeTasks complete: console.log(`\n\x1b[32m✅ Feature '${featureDescription}' added!\x1b[0m`); console.log(`   ${result.added} tasks added to tasks.json`); console.log(`   PRD updated: ${sectionName}`); console.log(`\n   Run \x1b[36mrocket loop\x1b[0m to start working on the new tasks.`)
